mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 5 trading days compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts below 1200 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST falls below 1200.0 but the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and federal funds rate signal a dual shock of labor market deterioration and monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in UNRATE and FEDFUNDS occurs but the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression has a positive coefficient.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production, the S&P 500 tends to underperform as manufacturing weakness signals reduced corporate earnings growth, leading to negative returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO is declining (e.g., INDPRO < 100), the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Fed to tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL yoy > 3.5 but 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer credit (RSAFS) over the past 60 days indicates rising consumer spending, which supports equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS increases but 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of rising unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%), the S&P 500 tends to decline as labor market weakness signals economic slowdown, producing negative returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.5% but 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal a broad-based economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Both HOUST and INDPRO decline but 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression is not significant (p>0.05).
